headline: US Clean Energy Investment Surges Past $74 Billion Midway Through 2026
meta_description: The US is on track for a record $180 billion in clean energy investment this year, with battery storage capacity reaching new heights.
summary_short: US clean energy investment hit $74 billion in the first half of 2026 and is projected to reach $180 billion by year-end—a historic milestone.
body:
The United States is on track to invest a record $180 billion in clean energy this year, with $74 billion already committed in the first half of 2026 alone.

Battery storage capacity has emerged as a standout winner in this expansion. The sector has reached 52 GW of installed capacity after sustaining 70% annual growth over three years—a pace that reflects surging demand for energy storage solutions alongside renewable deployments.

These figures signal that clean energy is no longer a niche investment. The momentum suggests infrastructure modernization and energy transition efforts are accelerating across the country, creating tangible progress toward decarbonization goals.
quick_facts: $74 billion in clean energy investment during H1 2026
Record $180 billion projected for full year 2026
70% annual growth in storage over three years
